    <h1>{`Overview`}</h1>
    <p>{`The `}<strong parentName="p">{`preloaded database`}</strong>{` is a performance optimization feature in Maximo Mobile that allows frequently-accessed, relatively static data to be pre-generated on the server and downloaded to mobile devices before synchronizing transactional data.`}</p>
    <p>{`This approach significantly reduces the time required for initial data synchronization by separating static reference data (like lookup values, classifications, and item masters) from dynamic transactional data (like work orders and service requests).`}</p>
    <h2>{`Key Benefits`}</h2>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Faster initial sync times`}</strong>{` - Users download pre-generated data instead of querying and building it on-demand`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Reduced server load`}</strong>{` - Static data is generated once and reused across multiple users`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Improved user experience`}</strong>{` - Quicker onboarding for new users or devices`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Efficient data distribution`}</strong>{` - Large reference datasets can be distributed without impacting sync performance`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h2>{`How It Works`}</h2>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-text"
      }}>{`Server-side Process:
1. Identify datasources marked with look-data="true"
2. Generate preloaded database file(s) based on partitioning strategy
3. Host preloaded database files on server

Mobile Sync Process:
1. User initiates sync
2. Device downloads appropriate preloaded database (based on partition)
3. Device then syncs transactional data
4. User can begin working with complete dataset
`}</code></pre>
    <h1>{`Purpose of the Preloaded Database`}</h1>
    <p>{`The preloaded database serves as a `}<strong parentName="p">{`static data foundation`}</strong>{` that is downloaded before transactional data synchronization begins.`}</p>
    <h2>{`What Data Belongs in the Preloaded Database`}</h2>
    <p>{`Data that is ideal for preloading typically has these characteristics:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Infrequently changes`}</strong>{` - Reference data that remains stable over time`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Shared across users`}</strong>{` - Data that many or all users need`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Large volume`}</strong>{` - Datasets that would take significant time to sync individually`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Read-mostly`}</strong>{` - Data that users consume but rarely modify`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h2>{`Common Examples`}</h2>
    <p>{`Typical data included in preloaded databases:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Lookup values`}</strong>{` - Domain values, synonyms, and classifications`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Item masters`}</strong>{` - Tools, parts, and materials catalogs`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Location hierarchies`}</strong>{` - Site structures and location trees`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Asset classifications`}</strong>{` - Asset types and classification structures`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Labor codes`}</strong>{` - Craft and skill definitions`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Failure codes`}</strong>{` - Problem, cause, and remedy codes`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Service address data`}</strong>{` - Customer locations and service territories`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h2>{`What Data Should NOT Be Preloaded`}</h2>
    <p>{`Data that should remain in transactional sync:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Work orders`}</strong>{` - Frequently changing, user-specific`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Service requests`}</strong>{` - Dynamic, assignment-based`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Inventory transactions`}</strong>{` - Real-time, transactional`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Labor entries`}</strong>{` - User-specific, time-sensitive`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Attachments`}</strong>{` - Large files, user-specific`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h1>{`Configuring Datasources for Preloading`}</h1>
    <h2>{`Marking Datasources for Preload`}</h2>
    <p>{`To include a datasource in the preloaded database, add the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`look-data="true"`}</inlineCode>{` attribute to the datasource definition in your mobile application XML.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<maximo-datasource
  id="itemDS"
  object-structure="MXAPIITEM"
  look-data="true">
  <schema>
    <attribute name="itemnum" searchable="true" id="attr_001"/>
    <attribute name="description" searchable="true" id="attr_002"/>
    <attribute name="itemtype" id="attr_003"/>
    <attribute name="status" id="attr_004"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h2>{`Important Considerations`}</h2>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Field Selection:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Only include fields that are actually needed`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Avoid selecting unnecessary fields that increase database size`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Consider mobile device storage constraints`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Query Optimization:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use saved queries to filter data appropriately`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Avoid overly broad queries that include unnecessary records`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Balance completeness with performance`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Related Data:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Consider which relationships need to be preloaded`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Avoid deep relationship chains that bloat the database`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Test the impact of related data on database size`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h1>{`Limitations of the Preloaded Database`}</h1>
    <h2>{`Single Saved Query Limitation`}</h2>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Critical Limitation:`}</strong>{` When multiple datasources use the same object structure with `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`look-data="true"`}</inlineCode>{`, only `}<strong parentName="p">{`one saved query`}</strong>{` will be applied across all of them.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Example of the Problem`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Datasource 1: Uses saved query "ACTIVE_ITEMS" -->
<maximo-datasource
  id="activeItemsDS"
  object-structure="MXAPIITEM"
  look-data="true"
  saved-query="ACTIVE_ITEMS">
  <!-- ... -->
</maximo-datasource>

<!-- Datasource 2: Uses saved query "STOCKED_ITEMS" -->
<maximo-datasource
  id="stockedItemsDS"
  object-structure="MXAPIITEM"
  look-data="true"
  saved-query="STOCKED_ITEMS">
  <!-- ... -->
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Result:`}</strong>{` Only one of these saved queries (typically the first one processed) will be used to generate the preloaded database. The second query will be ignored.`}</p>
    <h1>{`Partitioning Strategies`}</h1>
    <p>{`Partitioning allows you to create multiple preloaded databases tailored to different user groups, reducing the amount of data each user needs to download.`}</p>
    <h2>{`Why Partition?`}</h2>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Benefits of Partitioning:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Reduced download size`}</strong>{` - Users only get data relevant to them`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Faster sync times`}</strong>{` - Smaller databases download and process faster`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Better performance`}</strong>{` - Less data to search and filter on device`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Targeted data distribution`}</strong>{` - Different user groups get different data`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When to Partition:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Data requirements vary significantly by user group`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Database size is large enough to impact performance`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Users are geographically distributed`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Different sites or organizations have distinct data needs`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h2>{`Partition by Site ID`}</h2>
    <p>{`Partitioning by Site ID creates separate preloaded databases for each site, ensuring users only download data relevant to their location.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Use Cases:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Multi-site organizations with site-specific data`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Geographically distributed operations`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Sites with distinct item masters or asset catalogs`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Regional compliance or language requirements`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Configuration:`}</strong></p>
    <p>{`Refer to IBM documentation for detailed setup:
`}<a parentName="p" {...{
        "href": "https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/masv-and-l/maximo-manage/cd?topic=devices-creating-preloaded-data-mobile-using-siteid-language"
      }}>{`Creating Preloaded Data for Mobile Using Site ID`}</a></p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Key Steps:`}</strong></p>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Enable site-based partitioning in Maximo configuration`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Configure datasources with appropriate site filters`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Generate preloaded databases for each site`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Configure mobile app to request site-specific database`}</li>
    </ol>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example Scenario:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-text"
      }}>{`Organization with 3 sites:
- Site A (BOSTON): 5,000 items, 2,000 assets
- Site B (CHICAGO): 4,500 items, 1,800 assets  
- Site C (DENVER): 3,000 items, 1,500 assets

Without partitioning: Each user downloads 12,500 items, 5,300 assets
With site partitioning: Each user downloads only their site's data
- Boston users: 5,000 items, 2,000 assets (60% reduction)
- Chicago users: 4,500 items, 1,800 assets (64% reduction)
- Denver users: 3,000 items, 1,500 assets (76% reduction)
`}</code></pre>
    <h2>{`Partition by Person Group`}</h2>
    <p>{`Partitioning by Person Group creates preloaded databases based on user roles or organizational groups, allowing role-specific data distribution.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Use Cases:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Different crafts need different tool/part catalogs`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Supervisors need broader data than technicians`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Specialized teams work with distinct asset types`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Role-based data access requirements`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Configuration:`}</strong></p>
    <p>{`Refer to IBM documentation for detailed setup:
`}<a parentName="p" {...{
        "href": "https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/masv-and-l/maximo-manage/cd?topic=devices-creating-preloaded-data-mobile-using-person-group"
      }}>{`Creating Preloaded Data for Mobile Using Person Group`}</a></p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Key Steps:`}</strong></p>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Define person groups in Maximo`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Configure person group-based partitioning`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Associate users with appropriate person groups`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Generate preloaded databases for each person group`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Configure mobile app to request group-specific database`}</li>

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example Scenario:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-text"
      }}>{`Organization with 3 person groups:
- ELECTRICIANS: Need electrical items, tools, and codes

- HVAC: Need HVAC items, tools, and codes

Without partitioning: All users download all items (15,000 total)
With person group partitioning:

`}</code></pre>
    <h2>{`Partition by Language`}</h2>
    <p>{`Partitioning by Language creates preloaded databases with language-specific translations, supporting multilingual deployments.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Use Cases:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Multinational organizations`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Multilingual workforce`}</li>

      <li parentName="ul">{`Compliance with local language regulations`}</li>

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Configuration:`}</strong></p>
    <p>{`Refer to IBM documentation for detailed setup:
`}<a parentName="p" {...{
        "href": "https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/masv-and-l/maximo-manage/cd?topic=devices-creating-preloaded-data-mobile-using-siteid-language"

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Key Steps:`}</strong></p>

      <li parentName="ol">{`Configure mobile app to request language-specific database`}</li>
    </ol>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example Scenario:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{

Without partitioning: Each user downloads all language variants

    <h1>{`Managing Preloaded Databases in Maximo`}</h1>

Refer to IBM documentation for detailed management instructions:

    <h2>{`Best Practices`}</h2>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`✅ Do:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Regularly review and optimize preloaded datasources`}</li>

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`❌ Don’t:`}</strong></p>
